title: Run History
description: Standard report: every recipe run in the selected time range with unit, recipe, status, start, end, duration, cycles completed and release, filterable by unit, recipe and status.

list.name: unit
list.label: Unit
list.query: SELECT unit_id AS __value, unit_code AS __text FROM medcea.cea_unit ORDER BY unit_code
list.definition: SELECT unit_id AS __value, unit_code AS __text FROM medcea.cea_unit ORDER BY unit_code

list.name: recipe

panels.title: Run history
panels.description: Every run that overlaps the selected time range (started before its end and not ended before its start), filtered by the Unit, Recipe and Status variables. Duration of a running run counts up to now. Cycles are recipe steps the runner recorded as completed or failed. Recipes are shown by number: Grafana's database account may not read the recipe table.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT rr.recipe_run_id AS "Run", u.unit_code AS "Unit", rr.recipe_id AS "Recipe",
  CASE rr.recipe_run_status::text WHEN 'S' THEN 'Scheduled' WHEN 'R' THEN 'Running' WHEN 'C' THEN 'Completed' WHEN 'F' THEN 'Failed' ELSE rr.recipe_run_status::text END AS "Status",
  rr.recipe_run_start AS "Start", rr.recipe_run_end AS "End",
  extract(epoch FROM COALESCE(rr.recipe_run_end, CASE WHEN rr.recipe_run_status::text = 'R' THEN now() END)
                     - rr.recipe_run_start) AS "Duration",
  COALESCE(c.done, 0) AS "Cycles completed", COALESCE(c.failed, 0) AS "Cycles failed",
  rr.executed_by_name AS "Started by", rr.executed_by_role AS "Role",
  CASE WHEN rel.recipe_run_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'Released'
       WHEN rr.recipe_run_status::text = 'C' THEN 'Not released' END AS "Release"
FROM medcea.recipe_run rr
JOIN medcea.cea_unit u ON u.unit_id = rr.unit_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT recipe_run_id,
                  count(*) FILTER (WHERE recipe_line_cycle_run_status::text = 'C') AS done,
                  count(*) FILTER (WHERE recipe_line_cycle_run_status::text = 'F') AS failed
           FROM medcea.recipe_line_cycle_run GROUP BY recipe_run_id) c ON c.recipe_run_id = rr.recipe_run_id
LEFT JOIN medcea.run_release rel ON rel.recipe_run_id = rr.recipe_run_id
WHERE rr.unit_id IN ($unit) AND rr.recipe_id IN ($recipe) AND rr.recipe_run_status::text IN ($status)
  AND rr.recipe_run_start <= $__timeTo() AND COALESCE(rr.recipe_run_end, now()) >= $__timeFrom()
ORDER BY rr.recipe_run_start DESC

panels.title: Cycles of the runs shown
panels.description: The recorded cycles (recipe steps) of the runs in the table above, at most 1000.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.recipe_run_id AS "Run", u.unit_code AS "Unit", c.recipe_item_seq_id AS "Step",
  c.recipe_item_seq_cycle_num AS "Cycle",
  CASE c.recipe_line_cycle_run_status::text WHEN 'S' THEN 'Scheduled' WHEN 'R' THEN 'Running'
       WHEN 'C' THEN 'Completed' WHEN 'F' THEN 'Failed' ELSE c.recipe_line_cycle_run_status::text END AS "Status",
  c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_start AS "Start", c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_end AS "End",
  extract(epoch FROM c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_end - c.recipe_line_seq_cycle_run_start) AS "Duration"
FROM medcea.recipe_line_cycle_run c
JOIN medcea.recipe_run rr ON rr.recipe_run_id = c.recipe_run_id
JOIN medcea.cea_unit u ON u.unit_id = rr.unit_id
WHERE rr.unit_id IN ($unit) AND rr.recipe_id IN ($recipe) AND rr.recipe_run_status::text IN ($status)
  AND rr.recipe_run_start <= $__timeTo() AND COALESCE(rr.recipe_run_end, now()) >= $__timeFrom()
ORDER BY c.recipe_run_id DESC, c.recipe_item_seq_id, c.recipe_item_seq_cycle_num
LIMIT 1000
